description: Changes: cancels one booked stay; a late-cancel fee the hotel's policy sets is posted to its folio and left for the desk to collect (no card is charged, nothing is waived). Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Cancels a booked stay. First call without confirm: a preview (the fee or "no fee", the letter), nothing changes. Not for a stay booked on Expedia or Booking.com: cancel it there. Second step: after the preview, the call with confirm true sends a link to the person's own phone or e-mail; the change is made only when they open it and press Approve. Call again with the same values to learn whether it was made. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to go ahead with the change shown in the preview

reason_code.description: The hotel's cancellation reason, when it has a list
